items.title: Mayor Watters welcomed everyone and called the meeting to order.
Councillor MacDonald read the land acknowledgement.
Addendums and Corrections to the Agenda
Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest Under the Municipal Conflict of Interest
Demolition and Clean-Up of 25 West Mill Street Elora
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer provided an overview of the report, indicating 25 West Mill Street, is the location of the Elora Greenspace, a property owned by Suncor Energy Inc., and leased by the Township. He indicated on February 24, 2025, at approximately 3:30 pm, the roof and portion of the walls of the stone structure located on the property collapsed.
D. Wilson indicated the structure requires demolition due to its condition.

The owners of the adjacent property, Kat Florence Corporation, have expressed interest in participating in the demolition and clean-up since part of the debris is located on their property and the structure is attached to their building at 43 West Mill Street. He explained the involvement of the adjacent property owners in the demolition project presents a practical solution to several challenges, including safety and access related to the demolition. The terms of the agreement have been negotiated to reflect these interests while ensuring all demolition and clean-up work is conducted in compliance with municipal standards and regulations.
D. Wilson indicated Kevin Thompson from SV Law is present to respond to any questions.
D. Wilson responded to questions regarding responsibility for the building and whether regular inspections were conducted, and if the building was occupied.

Councillor Jefferson posed a question regarding the reimbursement of legal and consulting engineering costs and suggested the importance of the Township paying its own legal and consulting engineering costs to maintain the division of private and public responsibility.

items.title: A By-law to confirm the actions of Council

motions.item_title: Demolition and Clean-Up of 25 West Mill Street Elora
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington delegates authority to the Chief Administrative Officer to finalize and execute a Temporary Access and Demolition Agreement on behalf of the Township of Centre Wellington for the demolition and clean-up of the structure located at 25 West Mill Street, Elora, generally in accordance with the draft agreement appended to Report CAO2025-03; AND THAT the Township’s associated legal and consulting engineering costs be funded from the general capital reserve.
